extras.real_size: 5-piece drum kit, about 1.75 m wide, 1.3 m deep, 1.3 m tall
extras.notes: 22x16 bass drum with honey-wood hoops, spurs and kick pedal, 10 and 12 inch rack toms on a tom holder, 16 inch floor tom on three legs, 14 inch snare on a stand, 14 inch hi-hat with pedal, 18 inch crash and 20 inch ride on straight stands, round drum throne; mint lacquered shells, cream heads, silver hardware, brass cymbals; audience side = -Y, drummer sits at +Y; single object, no logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
